_notes: Universal card-extraction template. Every card (credit, debit, prepaid; any issuer) fills this same shape. Use null for 'not yet verified / unknown', use the string "N/A" for 'this field genuinely does not apply to this card' (e.g. cash_advance on a debit card, invite_only fields on an open-application card), and use [] for 'verified — this card has none of these'. Never delete a key because it doesn't apply — mark it N/A so downstream ingestion can tell 'not applicable' apart from 'not scraped yet'.

annual_fee_waiver.evaluation_condition: Annual fee of INR 1,000 (plus GST) is waived for the next year when eligible spend in the preceding anniversary year is INR 1,50,000 or more (T&C 3.6, page, MITC, SOC). Fuel and auto, railways, utilities, wallet, rent, government, insurance, cash, quasi-cash, education, miscellaneous, Bills2Pay and EMI conversions do not count.

welcome_and_renewal_gift.condition: Four BookMyShow movie tickets worth INR 1,000 (INR 1,000 discount or 4 free tickets, whichever is lower): two transactions of up to INR 500 each, minimum two tickets per transaction. Needs a valid retail transaction within 30 days of issuance and payment of the first-year fee by the first payment due date; valid 60 days after the first statement (T&C 3.1, page).

value.rule: Up to 3.99% per month (47.88% a year). MITC bands by CIBIL score: above 775 = 3.35% a month, 725 to 775 = 3.85%, below 725 = 3.99%. Interest-free period up to 50 days, not available if the previous balance was not paid in full or cash was withdrawn.

value.note: The draft stores the 3.99% maximum. The band a given cardholder gets is not published per card.

open_questions: Value of one reward point (checked again 2026-11-07): no RBL document states it for Movies & More. Not on the issuer page, the Movies & More T&C (3.3, 3.4), the BookMyShow offers guide, the SOC, the MITC, the Cardmember Agreement, or the Rewards Programme T&C (RWD 4.1 refers to "the value applicable to the product specific value proposition" without a number; RWD 3.1 says accrual varies by card). The redemption screens sit behind the rewards login, which was not opened. point_value_inr_baseline and effective_base_return_percent are null, as the brief requires. A person with a Movies & More login can read the per-point value off the portal.

Network (confirmed 2026-11-07): the RBL network availability guide (issuer page, undated) ticks "Movies & More Credit Card" for MasterCard only, not Visa or RuPay. The T&C names "MasterCard, VISA & RuPay" only as the networks whose MCCs classify dining outlets (3.3 i), which says nothing about this card.

Cap wording is "a maximum of 1000 accelerated reward points per month (1000 on dining and 1000 on the select merchants)". Modelled as total points under each accelerator per billing cycle; it could instead mean bonus points above the base rate. After the cap the T&C says spend earns the base 1 point per INR 100 (T&C 3.3 iii), which is modelled.
T&C 3.2 says the monthly offer applies on booking a minimum of 2 tickets, yet the INR 250 tier is for one ticket (page and BookMyShow guide). The page and guide figures are modelled.
Contracted services appear in the T&C 3.8 table and the page footnote but not in the category list of T&C 3.3 vi; treated as excluded.

Whether new applications are accepted (checked 2026-11-07, still open): the RBL card list shows "Know more" only for Movies & More (no "Apply Now", no "Express Your Interest"), and the product page has no card-specific application control (its only Apply Now buttons are the site-wide World Safari menu links) and no sentence about invitation, discontinuation or transition. The Popcorn page, by contrast, carries a notice that existing Popcorn cards are being transitioned from 20 Dec 2025, and the SaveMax Pro page says "invite only"; Movies & More and Blockbuster carry neither. The page text speaks in the present tense ("comes at an annual fee of INR 1,000"). application_mode is left null. Action: ask RBL whether Movies & More is open to new applicants.

T&C 4.4 refers to "the Play Credit Card" and 3.1 iv names the shared BookMyShow offer "Popcorn, Fun Plus, Movies & More, Blockbuster"; these look like copy-paste in the T&C and do not change the terms read.
Milestone year is "one year from the date of card issuance" (T&C 3.4 v); spend of add-on cards counts (3.4 vii). Stored as card_anniversary_year.
Points expiry: the Cardmember Agreement 12.19 says points not redeemed within 24 months expire; the product T&C does not override it. Stored as 24.
Interest: the SOC and MITC give "up to 3.99% a month" and score bands (3.35%, 3.85%, 3.99%); no per-card rate is published, so the 3.99% maximum is stored.

The per-card T&C carries no printed revision date. PDF creation dates are quoted in the sources list; the SOC (4 Jun 2026), MITC (29 Oct 2026) and Cardmember Agreement (27 Oct 2026) carry footer reference codes with dates.

Joining fee: the MITC says "Joining Fee NIL" and charges the first-year membership fee after the first debit transaction. joining_fee_inr here repeats the SOC "Annual Fee (1st Year)" so the first-year cost is visible, the same convention as the Shoppers Stop overlay.
notes: Network is Mastercard only (RBL network guide and issuer page).
Bonus points are credited within 30 days of the transaction or of crossing the milestone threshold (T&C 3.3 vii, 3.4 vi).

Fuel surcharge waiver: 1% up to INR 100 a month on fuel purchases between INR 500 and INR 4,000; INR 499 or less pays a INR 10 surcharge, INR 4,001 or more pays 1% with no waiver; GST is not reversed (T&C 3.5).
The 10% BookMyShow discount (up to INR 100 per booking, 15 times in a calendar year, primary card only) is a separate benefit from the monthly tier offers (T&C 3.7).
If the customer holds another RBL card, the credit limit of the new card merges with the existing limit (T&C 4.10); not modelled.
